exceptions.reason: openidconnect 4.1 requires rsa 0.9. Hubuum's OIDC adapter only verifies provider signatures with public keys; it does not decrypt or sign with RSA private keys. Private signing exists only under cfg(test) using a committed disposable fixture. Upgrade when openidconnect supports rsa >=0.10 and remove this exception; any production RSA private-key use invalidates it. See docs/supply-chain-security.md and issue #577.
